title: Depth 10 -> 12 at constant width 512
description: DEPTH 10 -> 12 and ASPECT_RATIO 48 -> 40, so model_dim stays 512 with 4 heads of 128; pure depth change, nothing else touched.
reflection: POSITIVE: val_bpb 0.986277 vs baseline 0.989007, i.e. -0.0027, about 3x the ~0.0009 noise floor. Depth still pays but the marginal gain is shrinking fast: 8->10 bought -0.0082, 10->12 buys -0.0027. Numbers: params 60.8M -> 71.3M, FLOPs/token 2.96e8 -> 3.46e8 (+17%), total_tokens 381M -> 331.5M (-13%), num_steps 2529, steady-state MFU 38.48% (roughly flat vs 37.8%, so the MFU-rises-with-depth effect has saturated), peak VRAM 27.1 -> 32.1 GB. Read the trend as diminishing returns on the pure-depth axis: extrapolating the same decay, depth 14 is worth maybe -0.001, which is at the noise floor and costs another ~13% of the token budget plus ~5 GB VRAM. I would NOT spend a slot on depth 14 next; the better move is either width (ASPECT_RATIO up so model_dim -> 640 at depth 12, which also raises dmodel_lr_scale automatically) or something that buys quality without buying FLOPs, since we are now at only 331M tokens and the token budget is getting genuinely tight.
